notes: No model in examples/, recipes/, serve/, docs/ or model code reads this class (repo-wide grep; only earth2studio/data, lexicon, CHANGELOG and docs/modules/datasources_analysis.md mention it), so winning_model is null and variables are the source lexicon. WB2Lexicon.VOCAB has 105 keys; u100m and v100m are excluded because this store has no 100m wind arrays (checked by listing the zarr group), leaving 103.

UCast opens the same 240x121 zarr directly with xarray for static fields (earth2studio/models/px/ucast.py:57-59,800-804) and GraphCastSmall/GenCastMini only import WB2Lexicon for name mapping; none of them use this data class. DLWP is paired with WB2ERA5 (examples/07_misc/01_distributed_manager.py:121), not the low-resolution variants.
Valid range 1959-01-01..2023-01-10T18:00, 6-hourly (earth2studio/data/wb2.py:259-271). Includes static lsm and z.
